purpose: Teach: よせ/想う/絶好調/道端/窮屈/ハメ/等しく/踏み出し

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、人を悪く言うのはよせって、お父さんが仰ったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said not to speak badly of people.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, gentle firmness. Relaying a household rule without lecturing. Calm, steady breath. Eyes level with his.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんを想うと胸がいっぱいになるよ
lines.en: Mom, when I think about Grandpa, my heart gets so full.
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. Words come slowly, like he's discovering the feeling as he speaks. Sincere and unselfconscious. Eyes slightly distant.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは今、お仕事が絶好調らしいわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's work is going really well these days.
lines.style: Light, pleased tone. A little lift on the good news. Warm but not overstating it. The tone of sharing something nice that happened.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、道端でかわいいお花を見つけたよ
lines.en: Mom, I found the cutest flower on the way home.
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick energy at the start. Eager to share, expecting delight from her. Open and unguarded.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、この服、ちょっと窮屈そうね
lines.en: Sho, this shirt is getting a little snug on you.
lines.style: Observational, gentle. Not a complaint — just noticing. Slight maternal warmth. The tone of someone taking mental note for practical reasons.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お友達と仲直りするハメになっちゃった
lines.en: Mom, I ended up making up with my friend.
lines.style: A hint of wry resignation underneath. Acknowledging something he didn't plan for. Matter-of-fact but with quiet humor. Small, genuine.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、おやつは皆で等しく分けましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's make sure everyone gets an equal share of the snack, okay?
lines.style: Clear, purposeful instruction. Not unkind — teaching a principle. Steady, unhurried. The tone of someone setting a quiet standard.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、新しい一歩を踏み出した気分だよ
lines.en: Mom, it feels like I took a real step forward today.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his own voice. Calm certainty, not bragging. Words land with weight. Eye contact held. The tone of someone who surprised himself.
